$comment: Exact reviewed architecture exceptions and analyzer findings. Count-only scopes and broad suppressions are forbidden.

exceptions.rationale: Raw Windows calls are confined to reviewed owner-local adapters with explicit RAII and shutdown proof.
exceptions.risk: An unreviewed adapter could leak handles, privileged state, or sensitive data across an owner boundary.

exceptions.rationale: These files are canonical sub-owner facades and remain logic-free under the facade guardrail.
exceptions.risk: A broad facade can hide business logic or aggregate unrelated owner surfaces.

exceptions.rationale: These waits are named, bounded polling intervals owned by cancellable runtime loops.
exceptions.risk: Unbounded or anonymous sleeps can hide deadlocks, latency, and missing shutdown ownership.

exceptions.rationale: The thin recording adapter delegates effective quality calculation to settings-owned policy.
exceptions.risk: Additional recording-to-settings imports would create duplicate settings authority.

exceptions.rationale: Pinned actionlint 1.7.12 predates GitHub self-repository syntax. This same-commit reusable workflow has server-side resolution, and verify_tooling rejects any other target; zizmor ignores only the exact uses scalar.
exceptions.risk: The newer self-repository syntax must be adopted after an aged compatible actionlint release is available. No external Action or untrusted workspace checkout is allowed by this exception.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove when the pinned workflow checker accepts this exact canonical self-reference without the exception.

exceptions.rationale: Preserve only the enumerated existing scenario-file limits. Each exact file has its own reason and ceiling; verify_boundaries rejects stale or over-limit entries.
exceptions.risk: Broad size exemptions can hide unrelated responsibilities and navigation costs.

exceptions.rationale: These exact cfg(test) fixtures parse hostile presentation payloads and verify unchanged persisted bytes. Only the listed read/parse operations are admitted. Exact parent declarations prove test-only compilation and make removed gates stale.
exceptions.risk: A broad exception could admit production parsing outside its owner. Production parent paths receive no parse/read permission.

exceptions.rationale: ADR 0008 permits the Tauri-owned runtime for system WebView presentation. The direct product dependency ban remains enforced.
exceptions.risk: An additional caller could create a parallel runtime or bypass resident shutdown ownership.
exceptions.removalCondition: Remove this exception when Tauri no longer needs Tokio. Review it if the pinned Tauri version or the exact wrapper scope changes.

technicalDebt.rationale: ADR 0002 requires separate pipe-secret and media-key DPAPI authorities. A shared crypto helper would erase that boundary.
technicalDebt.risk: A broader exception could hide unrelated cryptographic duplication.
technicalDebt.removalCondition: Remove when this exact finding no longer exists or an accepted owner change replaces this rationale.
technicalDebt.targetAction: Retain these exact adapters and review them against ADR 0002.
